title: Moray Industry And Elderly Care | 默锐工业与养老整合包
description: 在 Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge 上，将硬核工业自动化与温馨田园养老生活完美融合的模组包。 / A perfect fusion of hardcore industrial automation and cozy pastoral retirement life on Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge.
body:
## 📖 项目描述（中文 / English）

### 中文

**默锐工业与养老整合包**

欢迎来到《默锐工业与养老整合包》——一个精心打造的 Minecraft 整合包，将工业自动化与悠闲的田园生活完美融合。基于 Minecraft 1.21.1 和 NeoForge，本包让你既能建造宏伟的工厂，也能享受宁静的农耕时光。

**核心特色**

- **工业与自动化** – 包含机械动力、通用机械、沉浸工程、工业先锋等模组。构建复杂生产线，实现全自动化。
- **农业与烹饪** – 农夫乐事及其扩展模组带来丰富的烹饪系统和新的作物。
- **探索与魔法** – 新生魔艺、植物魔法、灾变、更好的末地/下界等模组，增加世界深度与冒险乐趣。
- **存储与物流** – 精致存储、应用能源2、管道、精妙背包等，轻松管理海量物品。
- **性能与便利** – 铷、铁氧体核心、玉、JEI、鼠标手势等大量优化与辅助模组，保证流畅体验。

**模组出处**

本整合包包含了以下需要注明出处的模组，原始发布页链接如下：

- **更多村民 (More Villagers)** – 作者：SameButDifferent – [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/more-villagers)
- **简易村民 (Easy Villagers)** – 作者：henkelmax – [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/easy-villagers)
- **Chunky** – 作者：pop4959 – [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/chunky)
- **KubeJS** – 作者：Lat – [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/kubejs)

**运行要求**

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge（最新稳定版）

**注意**  
本整合包目前为 alpha 测试版，欢迎反馈和建议！

---

### English

**Moray Industry & Elderly Care Pack**

Welcome to the Moray Industry & Elderly Care Pack – a carefully crafted Minecraft modpack that blends industrial automation with cozy, pastoral living. Designed for Minecraft 1.21.1 and NeoForge, this pack offers a balanced experience between building massive factories and enjoying a peaceful farm life.

**Key Features**

- **Tech & Automation** – Create, Mekanism, Immersive Engineering, Industrial Foregoing, and more. Build complex production lines and automate everything.
- **Farming & Cooking** – Farmer's Delight and its addons bring a rich cooking system and new crops.
- **Exploration & Magic** – Ars Nouveau, Botania, L_Ender's Cataclysm, and BetterEnd/BetterNether add depth and adventure.
- **Storage & Logistics** – Refined Storage, Applied Energistics 2, Pipez, Sophisticated Backpacks.
- **Performance & QoL** – Rubidium, FerriteCore, Jade, JEI, Mouse Tweaks, and many optimization mods ensure smooth gameplay.

**Mod Attribution**

This modpack includes the following mods that require attribution. Original sources are linked below:

- **More Villagers** by SameButDifferent – [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/more-villagers)
- **Easy Villagers** by henkelmax – [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/easy-villagers)
- **Chunky** by pop4959 – [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/chunky)
- **KubeJS** by Lat – [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/kubejs)

**Requirements**

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge (latest stable)

**Note**  
This pack is currently in alpha. Feedback and suggestions are welcome!
